Address search uses TomTom, as Horizon Nav always has: it finds house numbers, postcodes and businesses most accurately. TomTom is also the backup for routes and traffic. The key is free.
Download the pack once on Wi-Fi and routes, search, speed limits and cameras keep working with no signal. It\'s a large download (a few GB), so it\'s best done at home.
Everything here can be changed later in Settings.
Get it at account.mapbox.com › Tokens: copy the Default public token (it starts pk.).
Horizon Nav is built for the car: big, clear guidance on Mapbox\'s 3D map, with live traffic, UK speed limits and cameras, and routes and search that keep working with no signal.
Horizon Nav keeps closing while it starts
Horizon Nav uses Mapbox for the map, live traffic, search and routes. It needs your own free Mapbox access token, so the map runs on your Mapbox account (it\'s free for personal use).
Horizon Nav works out when to leave with the traffic expected then, checks again half an hour before, and reminds you 10 minutes before and when it\'s time to go (while the app is open).
If the Allow button does nothing, the permission was turned down before: allow it in Settings › About & backup › App permissions.
